summary.description: One paragraph: what the change does and whether it should ship.

findings.description: Most severe first. One finding per root cause.

severity.description: BLOCKER only when reach is reachable.

file.description: Repository-relative path, or 'PR body' for a claim outside the code.

line.description: Line in the snapshot head; null when the finding has no line.

failure_scenario.description: Concrete input -> wrong output or crash.

reach.description: reachable: a production entry point reaches it today. latent: it needs an input, route or data that does not exist today. unknown: not decided.

reachable_from.description: The production entry point and the call path to the line; for latent, what is missing; for unknown, what you searched.

why_not_by_design.description: The rules file, manifest, plan, decision or test you checked, and why it does not make this behaviour intended.

evidence.description: The code, the command you ran and its output, or the input that breaks it.

suggested_test.description: The smallest test that fails today and passes after the fix.

fix.description: The smallest change that fixes it.

checked_and_sound.description: What you checked and found correct, one short item each.

not_checked.description: What you could not verify, and why.
